Project RAINDROP from UCLouvain and UNamur

RAINDROP aims to address in a unique way the challenge of building, deploying, and operating applications on upcoming cloud infrastructures formed of a continuum of core (data centers) and edge resources. Read more.

Latest news

Welcoming new postdoc researchers

01 Oct 2026

Welcome aboard, Dr. Bochra Boughzala and Dr. Xiaokun Xu!

We are delighted to welcome two new postdoctoral researchers, Dr. Bochra Boughzala and Dr. Xiaokun Xu, to the RAINDROP research group at UCLouvain.

Dr. Bochra Boughzala recently earned her Ph.D. from the University of Groningen, Netherlands, where her research focused on accelerating real-time data analytics with in-network computing.

Dr. Xiaokun Xu completed his Ph.D. last year at Worcester Polytechnic Institute, USA, specializing in measuring and improving the Quality of Experience in cloud-based game streaming.

Best Paper Award at SRDS 2026

VISSOFT 2026

15 Sep 2026

Maxime presented at VISSOFT 2026

On September 15th, 2026, Maxime presented his works at VISSOFT 2026.

The paper Visualizing the Evolution of Data Access in Microservices present new visualizations and metrics to analyze and understand the history of data access in distributed and heterogeneous codebases. These interactive instruments are actionable on our oneline tool called DENIM.
